howto.what_en: Claude helps configure MCP servers for the workspace, such as web search, GitHub, or filesystem. It checks current config, adds new server entries, and verifies after restart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when adding a new MCP-backed integration (e.g., web search, GitHub) or diagnosing why an existing MCP server isn't responding.
